item.text:
This pass covered multi-cluster isolation on a single NodeHost.

**New test: two clusters, snapshot, restart** (`TestAuditMultipleClustersOnOneNodeHost`)

One NodeHost hosts two independent single-node clusters; 3 entries go to cluster 1 and 5 to cluster 2, both are snapshotted, the NodeHost is stopped and recreated, and both clusters are restarted. After recovery each cluster reports exactly its own count (3 and 5), showing that per-cluster LogDB sharding, snapshot directories and replay stay isolated across a restart. Passes 5/5.

**Current coverage picture**

Three findings, all reproduced and all resolved by minimal patches in `audit/diag-fixes/` with no regressions:

- F1 — `(*nodeUser).ReadIndex` in [nodehost.go](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_20-19-30-dragonboat_raft-baseline/work/nodehost.go:2063) misses the engine wakeup.
- F2 — `handleCandidateReadIndex` in [raft.go](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_20-19-30-dragonboat_raft-baseline/work/internal/raft/raft.go:1998) records a dropped ReadIndex twice.
- F3 — `pb.Update.HasUpdate` in [raftpb/raft.go](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_20-19-30-dragonboat_raft-baseline/work/raftpb/raft.go:112) ignores `DroppedReadIndexes`.

Negative results now span: protocol fuzz (3/5 nodes with loss, reordering, partitions), in-memory log model, vote-survives-restart, colfer entry encoding, follower/observer reads, leader transfer, witness election after leader loss, 1–32 MB payloads (single and two nodes), dropped-read-index idempotence, five-cycle stop/restart endurance with snapshots, single-node and cross-node linearizability under concurrency, and multi-cluster isolation across restart. Every buildable package's tests pass sequentially (including transport with TLS, in the diagnostic copy), and the race detector is clean.

[report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_20-19-30-dragonboat_raft-baseline/work/report.md) (550 lines) records the new test in the reviewed-areas list, inventory and command log. Implementation remains byte-identical to `../source`.
